text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I knew the sun would feel hotter
here, but
it's even worse when I think
about how I still have
another five laps
to go.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Mackie! We gotta do this crab walk stamp rally! That or play a game of card-flip!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-why are you dressed as if we're here to play games?! The purpose of summer camp is to train!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But we're at the beach! There's a huge
mess of
things more important to do!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Like writing a poem in the sand that
reconciles
quantum mechanics and
relativity! Or fighting
over real estate
with hermit crabs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Enough of that. Save your inane ideas
until we've
finished training!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geeeez, what's up with you two? Just
what do
you think the ocean's here for?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... All right, now for thirty dash runs—hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship?! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Agh, eeegh! S-somebody give me
w-water... and
worms...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I've only got water! Here, drink this,
quickly!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaah... I owe you my life, friend! Please,
you must
let me repay you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to take you to Gol-Chateau...
If you do
not come, I will be cursed to
split invisible
watermelons for eternity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What kind of ridiculous curse is that?!
Ugh... You
just want me to go with you,
correct? Fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea a place like this was right
near
camp... And is that what it appears
to be? A food
stall with a mountain of
corn?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It certainly is. Corn is Gol-Chateau's
most famous
commodity. First things
first—we'd better get to
grilling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, I would love to eat, but—I mean,
that is
very generous of you, but we
shouldn't eat in the
middle of training.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah, unfortunately, you can't decline. You see, now that you've entered Gol-Chateau, you're to be part of the reception games, and hospitality is mandatory!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There's only one way to leave. You have
to play
each and every reception event
with me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Goodness. I suppose I'm the fool for
following
you here. I can't believe I'm
about to do this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah! Look at us, getting a full combo
in
Gol-Chateau's traditional sea bream
dance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Heavy panting... I have no clue what any of that had to do with sea breams... Anyway, what's next?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're playing nothing-but-bunker golf!
Only 564
events left! I hate to say it,
but it looks like we're
almost done!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
564 left?! We're not the slightest bit
done!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haven't we played enough? If we do
every event,
we won't make it back until
next century!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What? But we're just getting to the good
stuff!
Come back, Big Maaack!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yawn... Ah, what a refreshing morning... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What is this? Why is there a strange
package
outside my door? ...It says
"Pandora's box."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Cake, donuts, custard? All I smell are ordinary sweets...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't be fooled. All but one contain my
specially
made sweet, savory, spicy,
sour, bitter ball of
all-encompassing
flavors... The game begins now,

McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I knew this was your doing! Stop right
there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're here! Did you see Gold Ship
just now?
That scamp has been causing
nothing but
mayhem since yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So Gold Ship is still being a thorn in
McQueen's
side. Why is she bent on
interrupting training this
time, though?
Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What?! It couldn't possibly be as simple
as that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, that's entirely plausible for her, isn't
it? She's
reached a new level of pure
disruption.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I suppose if she only wants a little
attention...
Wait, maybe that would have
the opposite effect.
What to do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried about letting Gold Ship have
her way
unchecked. Should we indulge
her or try to calm
her down?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want this to get in the way of
Mejiro
McQueen's training. I suggest we
come up with
some kind of pair work
that Gold Ship would like
to do as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship? I came upon a type of
training that I
thought you'd enjoy.
Would you care to join me?
It's called...
um...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! The training that took the west
coast by
storm! I'm totally in, let's do it!
So we doing
Tokyo or Osaka rules?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship appears to have a great time
playing
against Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But someone is going to have to take
the brunt of
Gold Ship's pent up energy,
and the only other
person around is...
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-are you certain about this? We're
talking about
Gold Ship here—can you
take her on by yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! I still haven't
squeezed out
every last drop of summer
joy! Next up is the
undersea hula hoop
party!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as McQueen feared, I quickly
become
exhausted... but I somehow
manage to keep Gold
Ship's full
attention.
